summary: users list + deep dive: DataTable + FilterPills + BudgetBar + CSV export
description:
Users list (/admin/users) + deep dive (/admin/users/[id]) per BRD §1.6, §1.7, design §4.2, §4.3.  Includes CSV export per BRD §1.18 for both the list and per-user sessions.

Files:
  - src/app/(admin)/admin/users/page.tsx  (new — list)
  - src/app/(admin)/admin/users/[id]/page.tsx  (new — deep dive)
  - src/app/api/admin/users/route.ts  (new — JSON list)
  - src/app/api/admin/users/[id]/route.ts  (new — single-user JSON)
  - src/app/api/admin/users.csv/route.ts  (new — streaming CSV, same filters as JSON)
  - src/app/api/admin/users/[id]/sessions.csv/route.ts  (new — streaming CSV)
  - src/components/admin/DataTable.tsx  (new — design §3.3)
  - src/components/admin/FilterPills.tsx  (new — design §3.6)
  - src/components/admin/BudgetBar.tsx  (new — design §3.5)
  - src/components/admin/csv.ts  (new — small streaming writer, used by every .csv route)
  - src/__tests__/admin-users.test.ts, admin-csv.test.ts

Done when:
  - List view: filters (tier/created within/has queried/search) drive URL params; sort headers update URL; pagination 50/page; Download CSV link in footer respects filter state.
  - Deep dive: header strip with stat tiles + dual-axis budget bars; sessions list with row-click; preferences snapshot; recent rate-limit hits.
  - <BudgetBar> renders correctly when usd_limit IS NULL ('no cap' tag, no bar).
  - CSV export streams (verified by reading response with a slow client — no full body in Node memory).

Tests:
  - Filter + sort URL state round-trips.
  - Empty-state row renders when no matches.
  - CSV endpoint emits headers + ≥1 row chunk separately (Response.body.getReader() calls).
  - All endpoints 404 to non-admins (BRD §1.17 commitment).
